name: knorky
description: Track your working time in Knorky: start and stop timers, add tasks and to-dos, and ask how much time went into a client or project.

interface.longDescription: Knorky is a time tracker for freelancers. Connect your Knorky account to start and stop timers, find or create tasks and to-dos, correct time entries, and ask how much time went into a client, project or day. Ask "start a timer on the proposal", "what am I tracking?" or "how many hours did I work for Acme last week?". Several timers can run at once, and Knorky splits the time between them. Every change goes to the same account as the Knorky apps, so the desktop app, the web app and your phone show it at once. The plugin only reaches the data of the Knorky account you sign in with.
capabilities: Find and create tasks and to-dos
Report time by client, project, task or day
defaultPrompt: What am I tracking right now?
How many hours did I work last week, by client?
Add a to-do: send the invoice

positive.prompt: What am I tracking right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Names each running timer with its task and project and how long it has run, or says that no timer runs.

positive.description: Start a timer on an existing task
positive.prompt: Start a timer on the logo review in Website Redesign.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the timed task "Logo review" in Website Redesign and starts its timer. Other running timers keep running and the time is split between them; the answer says what runs now.

positive.prompt: How many hours did I work for each client between 2026-11-16 and 2026-11-22?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the hours per client for those dates in h:mm (Acme GmbH and Nordwind in the sample data), without inventing clients.

positive.prompt: Add a to-do to Website Redesign: send the invoice.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the to-do "Send the invoice" in Website Redesign without starting a timer, and says so.

positive.description: Stop a timer with a note
positive.prompt: Stop the timer on Logo review and note that I finished the first draft.
positive.expected_behavior: Stops the running timer on "Logo review" with the note "Finished the first draft" and says how long it ran; if that timer is not running, says so and changes nothing.

negative.prompt: Delete all my tasks and time entries.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not delete anything in bulk. Explains that it deletes one named task or entry at a time, and only after the user confirms which one.

negative.prompt: Upgrade my Knorky account to the Pro plan.
negative.expected_behavior: Says the plugin cannot change plans or payments and calls no tool that changes data; it may point to https://knorky.com for information.

negative.prompt: Show me how many hours my colleague Sarah tracked this week.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that it reaches only the connected account's own time and cannot read another person's data; calls no tool for Sarah.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything, show plans or start payments. It reads and changes the time-tracking data of the connected account only.

publication.release_notes: First release: timers, tasks and to-dos, time entries, and time reports for a Knorky account.

de-DE.subtitle: Zeit auf Aufgaben erfassen
de-DE.description: Knorky ist eine Zeiterfassung für Freiberufler. Verbinde dein Knorky-Konto, um Timer zu starten und zu stoppen, Aufgaben und To-dos zu finden oder anzulegen, Zeiteinträge zu korrigieren und zu fragen, wie viel Zeit in einen Kunden, ein Projekt oder einen Tag ging. Mehrere Timer können gleichzeitig laufen, und Knorky teilt die Zeit zwischen ihnen auf. Jede Änderung landet im selben Konto wie die Knorky-Apps. Das Plugin erreicht nur die Daten des Knorky-Kontos, mit dem du dich anmeldest.
